newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia load factor rose to 75 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Iberia load factor rose to 75 pct in August.

text.p: Iberia's passenger load factor (percentage of seats filled) rose to 75.2 percent in August from 73.1 percent in July, the airline said.
It flew 1.32 million passengers and 2.63 billion revenue passenger kms in the month, increases of 10.3 and 9.7 percent respectively over August 1995.
Passenger numbers in the first eight months of the year stood at 9.63 million, up 3.5 percent on 1995, and revenue passenger kms totalled 17.0 billion, up 6.6 percent.
Freight tonne kms rose 3.9 percent to 48.92 million in August and stood at 465.20 million in the eight month period, an increase of 3.9 percent.
Freight tonne kms flown in 1995 as a whole were 723.7 million, with a load factor of 80 percent.
